x: At last Akabusi has raised our game and we have a bronze medal but regrettably our own John Regis has gone out in the semis of the 200 metres.

With Redmond, Akabusi and Black also in good form, Du'aine earned himself a share in the UK All-comers Record of 3:00.93. A few more runs like that and he is going to find himself a regular in the UK team.
In winning his semi-final in 48.54 Matt became the fourth fastest Briton of all time behind Akabusi, Hemery and Rawlinson. The time is also inside the qualifying mark for the 2004 Olympic Games.
